author: Karl Rock
description:
At Clifton Beach in Karachi, Pakistan, I found one of the simplest but toughest beach challenges I've ever seen. But is it a scam?

The rules are easy: hang from the bar for more than 2 minutes and win a cash prize. Sounds easy, right? Not for long! This guy gave it his best shot, but holding on is much harder than it looks.

Do you think you could last the full 2 minutes? Let me know in the comments!
title: Is this even possible?
